text:
Marta: hey all — hi! I’m Marta, joining today as a product designer. Quick checklist Qs: I can’t open the Redwood Figma org (it asks to request access). Also trying to find the product roadmap + research templates in Notion. Who should I ping for short onboarding? thanks!

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Marta :tada: — invite sent to marta@redwood.ai for the Redwood Figma org. If you still see the request screen after 5m, run `/resend_invite figma marta@redwood.ai` or ping this thread. Roadmap (high-level): https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Roadmap-7a9f
Research templates: Notion > Product > Research > Templates (link: https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Research-Templates-2b3c). Also join #design and #product channels.

Marta: thanks — I clicked the invite but it still shows "request access" :

Jamie: hey Marta — welcome! i’ll add you manually. @Product Onboarding Bot can you escalate if the invite is stuck?
I can do a 15-min walkthrough of our Figma setup at 11:30 if that works. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 — i'll cover: where the published libraries live, how we version files, and where to find component tokens. Do you want access to both Mobile + Web projects?

Product Onboarding Bot: manual add complete — Marta was added to Figma team "Design · Product". If you still see a request screen, try a hard reload or open in incognito.

Marta: I can open it now, thanks! quick q: where is the design system docs page in Notion and are tokens published to figma?

Sam: welcome Marta :wave: Roadmap note — top-level roadmap is in Notion (link above). Detailed plans + milestones live in Linear under the Product workspace. For research assets: we store recordings + transcripts in S3 and link them from Notion pages. If you need `aws` read access ping @Ana or message infra. PMs also keep a short list of active studies in the Research backlog in Linear.
(For access to Linear use: `SSO -> Apps -> Linear -> Request access`)

Jamie: Design system: open the Figma file named "Redwood UI Library" (Assets → Libraries → Redwood UI). Tokens are published on the Design System page and synced to the token plugin. If anything appears unpublished DM me and I’ll republish.

Marta: perfect — saw the UI Library. small UX question: who owns the research repo & studies? want to find previous interview scripts to reuse.

Ana: hey Marta, welcome! I own the research repo (Design Ops). i’ve added you to the S3 bucket `redwood-research` and shared the Research Notion folder with you. Quick onboarding checklist I’ll DM you: 1) Figma — confirmed 2) Notion — confirm access to Product & Research folders 3) Linear — request via SSO if needed 4) S3 read — should be granted now, tell me if you still can't access 5) Join Research sync (Thursdays 9am).
Here’s a short one-pager: https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Research-Onboarding-Quick-Start-4d5e
If you want, I’ll add you to the study rota and drop a few interview scripts to browse.

Marta: amazing — thanks Ana & team! see you at 11:30 walkthrough :raised_hands: 

Jamie: cool — will send a calendar invite for 11:30 (15 min) and drop a short checklist in the thread: `Figma: join Design · Product team; Notion: Product + Research; Linear: request access; S3: confirm read; Meetings: Research sync invite`.

Sam: one more note — if you plan to shadow any user interviews this week i’ll add you to the recording permissions. ping me when you have a study ID.

Marta: will do. thanks everyone :)
